name: XAcceptedPortfel
caption: Əlavə modullar / Kreditlər / Qəbul edilmiş portfel

datasets.name: maincrprt
datasets.sql:
select  rownum,ac.*,inf.*,grp.*,
brt.*,cred.*,act.*,flt.*,cour.*,(select sum(abs(pok_ostat)) from tenostat a where a.acc_id in (select id from account where kli_id=ac.cust_id and bal_cn1 in ('2501','2511')))as az_borc  from accepted_cr_portfels ac,accepted_cr_info inf,accepted_prtf_debts_grp grp,accepted_borrow_types brt,
accepted_cr_types cred,accepted_cr_actives act,filial flt,accepted_cr_court cour
where ac.info_id=inf.id and grp.id=inf.debt_grp and ac.credtp_id=cred.id and ac.active_id=act.id 
and brt.id=ac.borrow_type and  flt.id=ac.branch and ac.court_id= cour.id


















order by ac.prtid

datasets.name: mainloanacc
datasets.sql:
select a.*,acc_no||' qaliq='||(select abs(ostat) from tenostat
where acc_id=a.id) qaliq ,a.name from account   a

and (bal_cn1 like '25%'
or bal_cn1 in (2404,2434,2444,4506,4516,4801,4813))

datasets.name: Amountpays
datasets.sql:
select a.id,a.prtids,b.borrower_name,a.datdate,a.amount_main,a.amount_perc,s.val_name,c.descp,
cm_ak_reports.get_usernamebyid(a.userid)  usern,userid from

accepted_cr_payments a ,accepted_cr_portfels b ,accepted_portfel_settings c ,avalute s ,filial flt
where a.prtids=b.prtid and a.descpid=c.id and a.valute=s.valute and b.branch=flt.id
and trunc(a.datdate) between :dat1 and :dat2
union
select v.id,v.prtidsorcust,'',v.datdate,v.amount_main,v.amount_perc,'',v.info,'',v.userid from
accepted_cr_paymenterrors  v where trunc(v.datdate) between :dat1 and :dat2

datasets.name: tranzit_acc

datasets.name: Main_pay
datasets.sql:
select  rownum,ac.*,inf.*,
brt.*,pay.*,flt.*,pyt.*,val.val_name,cou.manages  from accepted_cr_portfels ac,accepted_cr_info inf,accepted_borrow_types brt,filial flt,
accepted_cr_paytypes pyt,accepted_cr_payments pay,avalute val,accepted_cr_court cou
where ac.info_id=inf.id and  pyt.id=pay.paytypes and pay.prtids=ac.prtid
and brt.id=ac.borrow_type and  flt.id=ac.branch  and pay.valute=val.valute and cou.id=ac.prtid
and 

trunc(datdate) between :dat1 and :dat2
and

ac.borrower_name =:brname












order by ac.prtid

 flt.id=ac.branch --and (cour.property is not null or cour.prop_desc is not null or cour.prop_address is not null or cour.porp_passport is not null  or cour.prop_price is not null or cour.prop_info is not null )

datasets.name: main_araryis
datasets.sql:
select prtid,borrower_name,(select types from accepted_borrow_types where id=v.borrow_type   ) nov,akt1,akt1_date,akt2,akt2_date,
case when restrukesas<>0 then
(select sum(restrukesas)+sum(aznesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )

else
(select sum(aznesas)+sum(restrukesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
end as aznesascem,


case when aznesas=0 then
 restrukesas
else
aznesas
end as aznesas,


case when aznfaiz=0 then
 restrukfaiz
else
aznfaiz
end as aznfaiz
 ,
 case when restrukfaiz<>0 then
(select sum(restrukfaiz)+sum(aznfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
else
(select sum(aznfaiz)+sum(restrukfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
end as aznfaizcem  ,
usdesas, (select sum(usdesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) usdesascem,
usdfaiz, (select sum(usdfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) usdfaizcem,
euresas ,(select sum(euresas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) euresascem,
eurfaiz,(select sum(eurfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) eurfaizcem,
ruresas,(select sum(ruresas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) ruresascem,
rurfaiz, (select sum(rurfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) rurfaizcem,
gelesas ,(select sum(gelesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) gelesascem,
gelfaiz,(select sum(gelfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) gelfaizcem,
gbpesas ,(select sum(gbpesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) gbpesascem,
gbpfaiz,(select sum(gbpfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) gbpfaizcem,
odenisesas,(select sum(odenisesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=0) odenisesasazncem,
odenisfaiz, (select sum(odenisfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=0) odenisfaizazncem,
(select sum(odenisesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=1) odenisesasusdcem,
 (select sum(odenisfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=1) odenisfaizusdcem,
 (select sum(odenisesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=45) odenisesaseurcem,
 (select sum(odenisfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=5) odenisfaizeurcem,
(select sum(odenisesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=48) odenisesasrurcem,
 (select sum(odenisfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=48) odenisfaizrurcem,
(select sum(odenisesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=475) odenisesasgelcem,
 (select sum(odenisfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=475) odenisfaizgelcem,
(select sum(odenisesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=3) odenisesasdbpcem,
 (select sum(odenisfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name and accepted_valute=3) odenisfaizdbpcem,

 round ((select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=1)* 
 (select sum(usdfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
  +    
 (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=45)* 
 (select sum(eurfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
  (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=48)* 
 (select sum(rurfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
  (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=475)* 
 (select sum(gelfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
  (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=3)* 
 (select sum(gbpfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
  (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=45)* 
 (select sum(eurfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
 
  (select sum(aznfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name),2) aznfaizekv,
  
 round ((select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=1)* 
 (select sum(usdesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
  +    
 (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=45)* 
 (select sum(euresas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
  (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=48)* 
 (select sum(ruresas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
  (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=475)* 
 (select sum(gelesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
  (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=3)* 
 (select sum(gbpesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
  (select ostat from operkurs where dat=sbop.get_date and val_kod=45)* 
 (select sum(euresas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name )
 +
 
  (select sum(aznesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ),2) aznesasekv,
accepted_valute ,

azalmemlakesas,azalmasehmesas,azalmguzestesas,azalmqarantesas,

azalmasehmfaiz,azalmemlakfaiz,azalmqarantfaiz,azalmguzestfaiz,
(select sum(azalmemlakesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) azalmemlakesascem,
(select sum(azalmasehmesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) azalmasehmesascem,
(select sum(azalmguzestesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) azalmguzestesascem,
(select sum(azalmqarantesas) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name) azalmqarantesascem,
(select sum(azalmasehmfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) azalmasehmfaizcem,
(select sum(azalmemlakfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) azalmemlakfaizscem,
(select sum(azalmqarantfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) azalmqarantfaizcem,
(select sum(azalmguzestfaiz) from accepted_cr_portfels where borrower_name=v.borrower_name ) azalmguzestfaizcem

 from accepted_cr_portfels v
where 
cust_id=:vid

order by accepted_valute

datasets.name: arayislist_agg
datasets.sql:
select LISTAGG(akt1||' nömrəli '||akt1_date||' tarixli,', ' ') 
         WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY accepted_valute ) akts,borrower_name borrowname from accepted_cr_portfels
         where cust_id=:vid and akt1 is not null and akt1_date is not null
 group by borrower_name
